# Leafium

**Leafium** is a lightweight, performance-focused Minecraft modpack designed to deliver a smoother, faster, and more enjoyable gameplay experience without changing the core feel of vanilla Minecraft.

### ✨ Features

* 🚀 Significantly improved FPS and overall performance
* ⚡ Faster world loading and reduced lag
* 🎮 Enhanced quality-of-life improvements for a better gameplay experience
* 🎨 Carefully configured resource packs and settings included out of the box
* 🛠️ Optimized configurations for stability and compatibility
* 🌿 Vanilla-friendly experience with modern enhancements

Whether you're playing on a low-end PC or want the smoothest Minecraft experience possible, Leafium provides the perfect balance of performance, usability, and visual polish.

### Included

* Essential for connectivity
* Performance optimization mods & resource pack
* Quality-of-life enhancements
* Pre-configured resource pack & theme
* Optimized configurations for the best experience

### What you have to do

* ⬇️ Download mods & res pack if needed (I don't think you need more)
* ⚙️ Configure mods settings, voice chat, essential & keybinds.
* 📄 Inform of any bugs or glitches here (link coming soon)

Install, launch, and enjoy Minecraft the way it should feel—fast, smooth, and effortless.
